title: Grateful Dead Live at Richfield Coliseum on 1994-03-21
lineage: DAT(m) > Sony DTC-59ES > SPDIF > Tascam HD-P2 > Audacity (16/48 > 16/44) > CDWave > FLAC; matrix by Roger Eichorn
source: Matrix of Source 1: SBD > DAT > CDR > SHNv3 and Source 2: AUD Source (handheld/ORTF/110^/DFC/FOB/18th Row) B&K 4011s > Neumann BS48i-2 > TCD-D3 > DAT(m)

ai_review.summary: Solid matrix mix captures a strong ’94 show with standout Peggy‑O, Queen Jane, He’s Gone and the Lovelight > Stella Blue > Lovelight sandwich.
ai_review.review: The matrix recording praised by listeners is clean and well‑balanced, letting the band’s tight playing shine through. Highlights include a smooth Peggy‑O/Queen Jane combo, an emotional He’s Gone, and a beloved Lovelight‑Stella‑Blue‑Lovelight sandwich, though a few reviewers were disappointed with the vocal delivery on Stella Blue.

ai_rating.rationale: Show receives strong praise for several songs and overall performance; recording is noted as a well‑done matrix. Mixed sentiment stems from two negative comments about the Stella Blue vocal, lowering confidence slightly.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Remastered matrix praised for clarity and balance; no major dropouts or muffiness reported.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Even with a slightly odd set order, the show flows smoothly; transitions—especially He’s Gone into Matilda Matilda and then into Drums—are highlighted as seamless.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Two reviewers criticize his vocal delivery on Stella Blue ('channeling Donna'), while others focus on his guitar work only indirectly.
band_member_comments.Drums: Positive note about an awesome segue into the Drum segment.
